notes.title: Full Release Patch
notes.content:
- Jaxson Paxton and Captured Naturepeep now have menu portraits
- 6 new songs added from 6 local New Orleans' musicians as collectable in-game vinyl
- Difficulty lowered for some enemies
- More dynamic ending scenarios added
- Multiple spelling errors fixed
- Crashes that have been reported have been fixed

tags.feature: - Jaxson Paxton and Captured Naturepeep now have menu portraits
- 6 new songs added from 6 local New Orleans' musicians as collectable in-game vinyl

tags.bug: - Crashes that have been reported have been fixed

notes.title: Patch Notes for August 3rd
notes.content:
[i][u][b]-The font issue has finally been fixed![/b][/u][/i]

(-Unfortunately a new error has happened that forces you to close out steam to stop running the game. I will be working the next week on solving that problem as well but it's a minor issue compared to the launch issues that are now fixed. )

-Some enemies have been scaled down due to difficulty spikes reported by testers 
-More environmental details added to quite a few areas
-Higher boosts and EXP provided to most activities besides battling
